outside_scope_leads: The June 16 timeline places --help revisions that are dated June 17; the detailed body dates them correctly. Host-frequency totals and the broad negative credential-string scan are not independently recomputed. The formal administrator label's zero revisions does not mean the deleting label had no restorative writes.
